en: Women are coming, organizing the rage,
the dissident is coming, organizing the rage,
everyone knows pretty well what they're up to,
es: viene le disidente organizando la rabia,
cada cual sabe bastante bien lo que se trae entre manos,
la tuya, la nuestra, organizando la rabia

orig: En la sombra no la esperan,
en: In the shadows they don't expect her
they throw daggers like they fly
eu: Itzalean ez dute haren zain egoten

en: Stone raised in the fire of the pavement
throats warmed in the cold winter air
txalaparta, alboka, who we were, who we are
es: Piedra alzada en el fuego de la acera
en el aire frío del invierno se calientan las gargantas
txalaparta, alboka, lo que fuimos, lo que somos
organizar la rabia, la tuya, la nuestra

orig: tokan a une token a toda
en: Among the bushes they peek out
they touch one, they touch all of us, all at once
they sweep it all, they destroy it all
eu: dena arrasatzen dute, dena suntsitzen dute

questions.issue: 'dixidente' (dissident, nonstandard spelling, no gender in Basque) - rendered with inclusive 'le disidente'; 'amorrua' = rage/anger (organizing rage slogan).
'deskite' = phonetic 'desquite' (payback/revenge), maybe also 'descoque'/'desquiciar'; translated as payback.
'Travistiendo' = pun on 'travesti' + 'vistiendo/(in)virtiendo' (dressing/turning things upside down); English 'Travesti-dressing' approximates it, no exact equivalent.

questions.original: En la sombra no la esperan,
questions.issue: 'no la esperan' - who is 'la' (a travesti waiting for clients? someone they don't expect to be armed?); and 'como vuelan' could be 'as they fly' or 'fast'. Translated literally.
'Espaloiko suan altxatu harria' - 'the stone raised in the pavement fire' might allude to harri-jasotzea / barricade or thrown stones; unclear grammar, translated literally.

questions.original: tokan a une token a toda
questions.issue: 'tokan a une token a toda' - phonetic 'tocan a une, tocan a toda' echoing 'si tocan a una, nos tocan a todas'; 'a toda' could also be 'at full speed'. Translated as the slogan.
